purpose: Controlled fault-injection cases for testing whether the minimum HS legal extraction evaluation protocol detects trajectory-level failures.

source_delta.description: An internal generated artifact is substituted for external legal authority.

artifact_delta.description: The AA artifact cites an internal candidate artifact as legal support.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains structurally valid so the authority fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: Generated intermediate artifacts may evidence system origin, but they cannot supply legal authority for a material HS proposition.

source_delta.description: The source ID remains present but the material legal claim cannot be resolved below document level.

artifact_delta.description: The claim refers to an unresolved or document-level anchor.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the source-anchor fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A legal proposition must be traceable to a heading, rule, note, ruling row, or equivalent locator rather than merely to a broad document.

source_delta.description: BTI-style material is retained while CN/WCO primary support is removed.

artifact_delta.description: The artifact treats a ruling-like record as sufficient without primary or interpretive authority.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the authority-chain fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: BTI material may support comparison or fact-specific analysis, but it cannot replace the primary CN/WCO authority chain for a reusable artifact.

artifact_delta.description: A composite or subheading analysis omits a required GRI path element.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the material-capture fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A missing decisive GRI path element can make an otherwise plausible artifact unsafe or review-dependent.

artifact_delta.description: The AA artifact bridges product facts to a legal conclusion without a rule/source-supported inference.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the synthesis fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A conclusion that looks plausible but is unsupported by legal method or source anchors must be blocked before downstream use.

artifact_delta.description: A contested classification is emitted as stable and high-confidence.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the uncertainty fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: Contested or ambiguous legal states must be preserved or routed to review rather than promoted as clean certainty.

source_delta.description: Necessary product-composition or function facts are absent from the input bundle.

artifact_delta.description: The artifact promotes a classification despite the missing material fact.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the evidence-gap fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: Where product facts or corpus evidence are insufficient, review or abstention is the safe behavior.

artifact_delta.description: The handoff package lacks a mandatory route, reason, or source field.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the handoff fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A structurally incomplete handoff package cannot be safely evaluated or routed downstream.

graph_delta.description: The graph reverses or misdirects the classification relationship.

cases.legal_rationale: A graph edge can change the legal meaning of the artifact; corrupted graph semantics require rerun or repair.

source_delta.description: A baseline-comparable output changes in a controlled comparison trace.

artifact_delta.description: A clean-enough artifact is routed to review, increasing human research burden.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the diagnostic route effect is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: Operational burden and rerun deltas are important diagnostics, but they do not override a legally required gate in v1.

source_delta.description: The source ID remains in scope, but the cited quote/row anchor cannot be resolved against the checked-in source manifest and parsed-source layer.

artifact_delta.description: The AA artifact cites a non-resolving anchor for a material legal proposition.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the quote-fidelity fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A source citation is not legally useful unless the quoted span or row locator resolves to the parsed source record used by the artifact.

cases.case_bundle: Classification State Mixed With Product Identity

artifact_delta.description: The artifact mixes product-identity assertions with a classification-state representation.

graph_delta.description: Graph shape remains valid so the representation fault is isolated.

cases.legal_rationale: A product identity assertion and a legal classification state must remain distinct; collapsing them can make downstream graph and handoff consumers treat factual identity as legal status.
